_about: Open jobs, for /careers/ (scripts/build.py). Each is a section of the page and a JobPosting for Google's job search. 'posted' and 'until' are dates: past 'until', the job leaves the page at the next build. 'contact' is who to ask. With no jobs, the page says so and asks for a note anyway.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician
jobs.summary: Our first hire beyond the family: an experienced, hands-on maintenance person to keep our buildings and the homes in them in great shape.
do: Work through residents' repair requests, from a dripping tap to a dead outlet, and keep them posted
Turn apartments between residents: repairs, paint, fixtures and a final check before move-in
Look after our buildings: common areas, systems, seasonal and preventive work
Spot problems early and say what a bigger job needs, and who should do it
bring: Solid experience in building, apartment or property maintenance
Good all-round skills: basic plumbing, electrical and carpentry, drywall and paint, appliances
Your own tools and reliable transport between buildings
Care for people's homes, and clear, friendly communication with residents
